roles.title: Vice President
description: Support the President in all executive functions and decision-making processes
Act as the President's primary advisor and strategic partner
Preside over meetings and events in the President's absence
Coordinate with various directors and committees to ensure smooth operations
Represent RSAMDIO at Zonal and international Rotaract events

roles.title: General Secretary
description: Maintain all official records, minutes, and documentation of RSA MDIO
Coordinate communication between the executive secretariat, board and committee member of RSA MDIO
Manage correspondence with RISAO, Districts, and DRRs
Oversee the preparation and distribution of official communications and programs
Ensure all activities are in compliance with RSAMDIO Bylaws, Rotaract Constitution and Rotary Code of policies.

roles.title: Secretary (Reporting / Communications / Initiatives / Special Programs)
description: Manage the planning and distributions for programs of RSA MDIO
Manage all reporting requirements.
Coordinate special programs and initiatives.
Create and distribute newsletters, updates, and official communications
Maintain relationships with external partners and board members

roles.title: Treasurer
description: Manage all financial operations for RSAMDIO
Oversee fundraising (foundation) activities and programs
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transparency across partners and stake holders
Coordinate with officials to ensure compliance and accuracy in data management across financial operations and foundation programs

roles.title: Sergeant at Arms
description: Maintain order and decorum during all RSA MDIO meetings and events
Oversee event logistics and arrangements for the meetings
Support the President in maintaining meeting protocols and traditions

roles.title: Chairperson - R.O.A.R.
description: Lead the RSAMDIO's Outstanding Awards & Recognition (R.O.A.R.)
Develop recognition criteria and evaluation processes
Coordinate with R.O.A.R. Committee, RSAMDIO Secretariat and the President to identify outstanding achievements
Corodinate & Organize recognition ceremony and award presentation

roles.title: Editor
description: Oversee all editorial content for RSAMDIO publications and communications
Edit and proofread all official documents, newsletters, and reports
Maintain editorial standards and brand consistency
Collaborate across teams for the creation of content for the RSAMDIO website and social media handles
Manage publication schedules and content calendars

roles.title: Zone Director / Coordinator
description: Coordinate activities and communication within assigned zones
Serve as the primary liaison between RSAMDIO and Districts
Facilitate Zone meetings, RSAMDIO initatives, and collaborative activities
Provide guidance and support to DRRs in achieving their goals and objectives
Represent RSAMDIO at Activities and Events of the Districts within the assigned Zone
Ensure that the Districts within the assigned Zone are well represented and supported by RSAMDIO
PS: Consider the time commitment and willingness to travel required to visit the Districts within the assigned Zone before nominating for this role

roles.title: Director - International Relations
description: Develop and maintain relationships with Rotaract organizations globally
Facilitate international service initiatives and exchanges with other Rotaract organizations globally
Facilitate cross-cultural learning and collaboration opportunities
Facilitate engagement and networking opportunities between District ISDs and International Service Chairs of member Districts
Manage international partnerships and memorandums of understanding

roles.title: Director - Service Programs
description: Develop and coordinate service initatives across the Rotaract South Asia
Support Districts in planning and executing service initiatives
Mange coordination and communication with Partners
Measure and report on service impact and outcomes to the Partners
Manage the Partnerships and Develeverables as per the Memorandums of Understanding with the Partners

roles.title: Director - Foundation Programs
description: Promote Rotary Foundation programs and iniatives
Educate members about Foundation grants and opportunities
Coordinate Foundation-related programs.
Maintain relationships with Rotary Foundation representatives and partners
Manage the Partnerships and Develeverables as per the Memorandums of Understanding with the Partners

roles.title: Director - Learning Programs
description: Develop and coordinate educational and learning programs
Create learning resources and materials for Rotaractors, Club Leaders and District Leaders
Facilitate learning andleadership development iniatives
Coordinate and manage relationships with Rotary International Learning Programs representatives
Promote continuous learning and Rotary International Learning Programs

roles.title: Director - Fellowship Programs
description: Develop and coordinate fellowship activites and networking opportunities
Coordinate Zonal fellowship activities and events.
Coordinate with the RI Director's office to integrate the Fellowship Programs and Initiatives
Create opportunities for Rotaractors to connect during RSA MDIO's events.

roles.title: Director - Membership Programs
description: Develop and execute strategies and initativies to help Districts promote growth and retention of Rotaract membership across South Asia
Coordinate and align with RI Director's office and RSA MDIO's goals and objectives
Promote the value and benefits of Rotaract membership

roles.title: Director - Design & Branding
description: Develop and maintain RSAMDIO's visual identity and brand guidelines
Create creatives and promos for communications, events, and marketing materials
Design publications, presentations, and digital assets
Ensure brand consistency across all RSAMDIO materials
Create Branding resources and templates for Rotaractors, Club Leaders and District Leaders

roles.title: Director - Marketing & Communications
description: Develop and execute strategies to promote initiatives and programs
Manage social media handles and digital campaigns
Provide narrative and content for creation of brand assets by Design & Branding Team
Create marketing and promotional content for social media channels

roles.title: Director - Web & Tech
description: Manage RSAMDIO's website, digital platforms, and technology infrastructure
Develop and maintain web applications and digital tools
Provide technical support for initaives and programs of RSAMDIO
